ns2:course.label: Honors Individual Study
ns2:course.description: Individual study and research projects for those students who are candidates for departmental distinction in anthropology. May not be taken concurrently with ANTH 390. Prerequisite: Senior standing; 3.2 GPA in anthropology; consent of instructor.
